dialog.speaker: Yuno...
dialog.win1: You won...? That's okay. I'm not angry. Not at you. Again?
dialog.win2: Wow, you're so smart. I love that about you. Play with me again~
dialog.win3: Hehe... Did you think I'd let you leave after that? One more game.
dialog.lose1: Checkmate~ You're mine now. Isn't that wonderful?
dialog.lose2: Don't look so sad. Just stay and play with me. Forever.
dialog.lose3: I'll always win, you know. Because I want you so much more than you want to win.
dialog.draw1: A draw... We're perfectly matched. It's fate, isn't it?
dialog.draw2: Neither of us wins. So you have to stay and finish it. Right?
